errors.text: The proposed yttrium addition does not reconstruct the hydride-assisted printing, hydrogen de-binding, gettered vacuum sintering, quenching, and silicide-coating strategy.
No evidence is cited that 1–2 wt% Y forms a continuous, adherent Y2O3 barrier on HfNbTaTiZr rather than internal oxides or brittle second phases.
The hypothesis does not address the oxygen-content and cooling-rate constraints needed to prevent alpha-HCP formation and embrittlement.
Mechanical-performance retention is asserted without specifying acceptable quantitative changes or controlling for microstructural changes caused by yttrium alloying.
